channel.title: NBC Sports Fantasy Football News
channel.description: Latest player news and analysis for fantasy football from NBC Sports.

item.title: Tyjae Spears (knee) is questionable for Tennessee’s Week 11 game against the Cowboys.
item.description: Spears hit the questionable line with this knee injury in Week 10, Week 7 and Week 6 before this latest one. Given how similar the pathing looks to last week’s — as he also got in a full session ahead on Friday here — we think he’s more likely to play than not. He’s probably only a desperation FLEX play in a good matchup against the Cowboys busted run defense.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Carnell Tate (shoulder) is questionable for Tennessee’s Week 11 game against the Cowboys.
item.description: The big news here is that he got in a full session on Friday after being limited on Wednesday and Thursday. The long layoff is still a little bit concerning, but a full session likely inches him over to the optimistic side of questionable in what looks to be a shootout. Tate will have high-end WR3 appeal if he’s able to go.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Vega Ioane (shoulder/knee) is not on Baltimore’s final Week 11 injury report.
item.description: He got in two full sessions on Thursday and Friday. Hopefully his return will help calm down the interior of the Baltimore offensive line. The Ravens will need all the pass protection help they can get if they keep playing as they did on Monday night.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Chris Bell (knee) is not on Miami’s final Week 11 injury report.
item.description: He’ll play against the Bills. It’s not exactly a smash play after he missed last week’s game with some soreness in his surgically-repaired knee, but it’s certainly plausible that Bell will be in the fantasy discussion in Week 12 if he proves healthy and able this week.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Dee Alford cleared concussion protocol and is not on Buffalo’s final Week 11 injury report.
item.description: He’ll be tasked with slot work against the Dolphins with Christian Benford (groin) out. It’s good news for Buffalo D/ST streamers that they’ll at least have one of Buffalo’s better corners back for this one.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Caleb Douglas (shoulder) is not on Miami’s final Week 11 injury report.
item.description: He got in a full session to evade the questionable line on Friday. With Buffalo’s banged up secondary and the run attack sliding to a halt without Malik Willis under center, it’s plausible that Douglas can cook up some real numbers this week. He is RotoPat’s 23rd ranked receiver this week as of Friday afternoon.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Jake Ferguson (ankle/knee) will not play in Dallas’ Week 11 game against the Titans.
item.description: Ferguson has now missed two weeks with this injury and has not practiced at all in the interim, leaving his status for a short turnaround Week 12 highly questionable. It is wheels up in the TE2 ranks for Brevyn Spann-Ford.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Chiefs ruled out Kenneth Walker (groin) for Week 11 against the Cardinals.
item.description: The Chiefs face the lowly Cardinals this week, but they face the Bills next week. Allowing Walker to fully heal in time for that important matchup makes sense. Stud rookie Emmett Johnson remains a fantasy football RB1 after an explosive showing against the Falcons last week. Walker will vault back into the RB1 tier upon returning.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Raiders coach Klint Kubiak said Brock Bowers (ankle/quad) is questionable for Week 11 against the Broncos.
item.description: We do not yet know Bowers’ Friday participation level. He was seen at practice, and Kubiak told reporters that Bowers got “a lot of work in.” Some reports indicate that Bowers spent time away from his teammates, working with trainers, though, so he could end up being a limited participant. The Broncos struggle to cover tight ends effectively. If active, Bowers is an elite TE1, albeit with some re-injury risk.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Roman Wilson (hand) is questionable for Pittsburgh’s Week 11 game against the Eagles.
item.description: He got in three full sessions this week and seems likely to be activated off injured reserve — most IR activations this season have received a questionable tag regardless of how often they’ve practiced. With the depth back in their receiving corps on Sunday (assuming Michael Pittman is also activated), we’d probably fade the non DK Metcalf pass catchers against Philadelphia and see how things sort out. It’s certainly not impossible that Wilson produces real fantasy value down the stretch despite the competition.-Rivers McCown
